items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1960-03-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Back by the Cloverland Derrick. From there, right up from there.

ctx.x: Not the street, but the section of town. Carrollton. Yeah, I mean, what part of the city is that? Yeah, that's a good town. That's true.
Back by the Cloverland Derrick. From there, right up from there.
Yeah. That is right. And over here on Eagle Street is the waterworks, where they pump that water.
